how: Competition tracks with fixed datasets and hardware budgets; entrants submit algorithms that are scored on recall and throughput under the constraints.
name: Big ANN Benchmarks
note: Where large-scale retrieval research shows up first; results flow into the engines that vector databases embed.
measures: Vector search at billion scale, including the hard variants production systems face: filtered queries, streaming updates, out-of-distribution queries, and sparse vectors.
not_measured: Small-scale or in-memory workloads typical of most applications, and full database products.
